items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Come on, Lou. You know who this is?

ctx.x: Come on, Lou. You know who this is?

Tell him to come on in. Come on in. I wanted to ask you about the different halls and different places you played. Did some of them have a better sound than others? Why certainly. Well I figured that. Which one would sound the best, you know, make it easy to play?
